evidence: Added new field 'Notes' with type Text via Fields dialog; field list showed it immediately, and a 'Notes' column appeared in the table view with '—' placeholder for existing entries.

issue: New entries do not persist across page reload
actual: Added entry 'Buy groceries' appeared immediately (6 entries), but after reloading the page the entry count reverted to 5 and the new entry, along with the newly added 'Notes' field, were gone. localStorage and sessionStorage were both empty, confirming no persistence mechanism.

evidence: Created entry with text 'Verify text field', number 42, date 2026-10-05, checkbox checked. Table view showed 'Verify text field', '42', 'Oct 5, 2026'; Card view showed same plus Completed='Yes'.
Switched Table→Cards→Table; all 6 entries and their field values remained identical and unchanged across view switches.

Table: sorted by Task Name ascending then descending, order correctly alphabetized both directions. Switched to Cards (reset to no-sort/insertion order), set Priority ascending sort there (1,1,2,2,3,42). Switched back to Table: still 'Sorted by Task Name (descending)' with correct order, proving independent sort state per view.

Selecting 'Task Name' from Sort dropdown immediately reordered rows alphabetically; statusbar showed 'Sorted by Task Name (ascending)', then clicking header toggled to '(descending)' with reordered rows. App remained fully interactive afterward (view switch, further sorting worked).
Before and after sorting by Task Name (asc/desc) and by Priority, entry count remained 6 and each entry's field-2/field-3/field-4 values were unchanged, only row order changed.

With sort cleared, dragged 'Design new landing page' via keyboard reorder (drag handle) in Table view to position 3: order became Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team, Verify. In Cards view (also sort cleared), dragged the same entry to a different position independently: order became Review, Update, Prepare, Team, Design, Verify. Switching back to Table confirmed its own order (Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team, Verify) was preserved, unaffected by the Cards view reorder — confirming independent manual order per view.

actual: No filter UI exists anywhere in the app. Checked toolbar, column headers, Fields dialog, and searched the full DOM for any element with 'filter' in text/class/aria-label/title or a filter icon (lucide-filter) — none found. Only Sort (by field) and quick Search are available; there is no way to define field-specific filter criteria.
No filter mechanism exists in the app (confirmed via DOM search for filter UI/icons), so filter criteria cannot be applied or cleared.

No import button, file-upload control, or any import UI exists anywhere in the app. The Fields dialog only contains a textual note ('Configure fields before importing data') but provides no actual import functionality. Searched entire DOM/page text for 'import', 'upload', 'csv', 'export' controls — none found.

evidence: Priority field uses native <input type='number'>. Attempting to type non-numeric text 'abc' was rejected outright by the browser/input (Playwright error: 'Cannot type text into input[type=number]' - fill action could not set a non-numeric value). Entering numeric value '15' was accepted and reflected correctly (value='15').

Due Date field uses native <input type='date'>. Forcing an invalid date string '2026-13-45' left the input value empty (browser rejected it). Entering a valid date '2026-12-25' was accepted and reflected correctly.

issue: Empty field value has no clear representation in either view
actual: Created entry 'Empty field test' with an empty Due Date value. In Table view the Due Date cell rendered completely blank (no placeholder text). In Card view the 'Due Date' label appeared with no value row at all, unlike other fields. Other fields with missing values (e.g. a newly-added text field for existing entries) displayed a '—' placeholder, so representation is inconsistent and the empty date has no clear indicator at all.

evidence: Fields dialog clearly lists type options 'Text', 'Number', 'Date', 'Checkbox' as labeled select options. Entry form provides matching type-appropriate native controls: text input (Task Name), number input (Priority), date picker input (Due Date), and a toggle switch (Completed).

Entry form shows a toggle switch with true/false state for Completed. Table view renders a colored check icon (text-success, lucide-check) for true and a muted x icon (lucide-x, text-muted-foreground) for false. Card view renders explicit text 'Yes'/'No' for the Completed field. Both checked and unchecked states are clearly distinguishable in all contexts.

issue: Quick search only matches raw internal values, not displayed formatted values
actual: Searching for the displayed date text 'Jan 18' (shown as 'Jan 18, 2026' in both views) returned 0 results, while searching the raw ISO value '2026-01-18' correctly returned the matching entry. Searching for the displayed checkbox state text 'Yes' (Card view shows 'Yes'/'No') returned 0 results even though entries with Completed=Yes exist. This confirms search matches only internal raw values, not the formatted values users see.

evidence: Typing 'REVIEW' (uppercase) filtered results to the single case-insensitive match 'Review marketing materials', with status bar updating to '1 entry matching \"REVIEW\"'. Clicking the clear-search action restored the count to '7 entries' and all original entries.
